info.title: UnitMarket public API
info.description: Version 1 of the public API. Runs offline in MVP 1: no payment provider is called by these routes.

post.summary: Issue an API key. The token is in this answer only; a repeat with the same Idempotency-Key returns the key without it.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 8 to 128 characters of letters, digits, underscore and dash.

400.description: A required header is missing or malformed (for example Idempotency-Key).

403.description: The credentials are valid but may not do this.

422.description: The request did not match the expected shape.

post.summary: Inbound payment provider webhook (existing route, unchanged)
post.description: Served at POST /api/webhooks/paypal. The payment provider calls it, never an API client. The route checks the provider signature over the raw body before it reads anything, answers with an empty JSON body, and is limited per address.

400.description: The body could not be read.

429.description: Too many requests from this address.
